items.name: Administrative review
items.description: Relevant service complaint, supervisor, statutory departmental appeal or CPGRAMS/state system where admissible. Check exclusions and deadlines.

items.name: Information / RTI
items.description: Existing records through lawful disclosure or RTI for eligible citizens, with appropriate appeals. Information access does not itself enforce a remedy.

items.name: Regulator or specialist redress
items.description: Competent regulator, ombudsman or statutory grievance body only within its remit and after applicable prerequisites.

items.name: Rights or protection route
items.description: Appropriate commission, protection service or specialist authority, subject to mandate and confidentiality. A recommendation is not necessarily a binding executable order.

items.name: Qualified legal review / competent court or tribunal
items.description: Qualified advice, eligible legal aid and proper judicial/tribunal procedure. No guaranteed admission, relief or timing.

items.name: Policy hearing / legislative scrutiny / lawful advocacy
items.description: Proposed affected-person hearing, eligible petition, representative scrutiny, consultation or lawful advocacy. Automatic hearings require institutional adoption.

items.name: Vigilance or audit referral
items.description: Competent vigilance, anti-corruption, social-audit or audit process. A referral is not a finding of guilt or a guarantee of compensation.

caveat: These routes are options, not a compulsory ladder. Urgent protection and individual relief must not wait for a public hearing.
